candidates.label: Prove a Lab-native witness before any legacy migration
evidence: CAL-PROP-0001 requires one initial witness and exact source admission; Decision 0002 requires selective dependency-closed migration.

candidates.label: Use one exact legacy ontology import as the first witness
evidence: CAL-PROP-0001 permits exact candidate imports that bind source repository, path or selector, digest, original owner, boundary class, and candidate posture.

candidates.label: Bulk-convert all repository ontologies immediately
evidence: Decision 0002 requires selective dependency-closed import and preserves unselected sources as external legacy evidence.
rejectionReasons: Bulk conversion lacks exact source admission, owner-local context selection, dependency closure, and a proven first vertical; it would also cross protected promotion boundaries without an owner gate.

candidates.label: Defer migration policy
evidence: Deferral allows a Lab-native mechanics witness but forbids importing existing ontologies.

candidates.label: Stop migration planning
evidence: Stopping terminates migration continuation without mutation.
